text:
sam: Quick check-in on marketplace announce sequencing. AMD told partnerships theyplan a microcode roll next Tue that will change MI300 sustained perf numbers. Nvidia flagged a small H200 firmware image with a kernel dep arriving mid-week. Habana says Gaudi kernel module 2.7 will land but likely after our canary. Do we want a single joint announce or stagger?
alejandra: Stagger imo. If MI300 numbers shift we risk having to retract or append corrections. We can still do a unified landing page but call out "initial availability" vs "performance profile updates".
ken: Ops question: can we tag SKUs with "pending-firmware" and hide them from buy flows until we validate post-image perf? Something like: ```sku_flags: ["available","pending_firmware"]```
sylvia: Product/legal prefer we avoid hiding SKUs if partners expect slotting; instead mark "alpha perf" and add a tooltip. Legal: must include a single line about "performance subject to firmware updates".
amanda_amd: From AMD side: microcode should recover some long-seq regressions. Weestimate ETA to partners = Tue evening PT. We'll provide a partner note and a test image.
nathan_nvidia: Nvidia: H200 firmware is low risk but requires kernel 5.19+ for some sched hooks. We'll share a compat matrix by EOD today.
raul_gaudi: Habana: Gaudi module expected to be stable but we recommend running our latest driver in staging. No public comms changes required from our side.
sam: Proposed plan: 1) Partnerships draft partner-facing compatibility matrix and pre-announce note (dry-run) by tomorrow. 2) Eng-runtime run perf sweep (long-context + short) for MI300/H200/Gaudi in staging images after each vendor image lands. 3) Marketplace: mark SKUs with a small banner "Performance profiles are provisional pending vendor firmware". 4) SI dry-run: keep integrations but delay outward SI demos until post-fix validations.
alejandra: Can partnerships own the draft? I'll take lead. Will we need a dedicated press embargo? Marketing wants a 72h buffer if numbers change.
sam: Marketing 72h buffer sounds right. Also need a fallback routing plan: if H200 derates >10% we route heavy seq to MI300 pools (if available) or B200 pools as lowest-cost fallback.
ken: I'll add sku_flags and banner text. Draft snippet: ```banner_text: "Performance profiles provisional; final numbers after vendor firmware updates."```
sylvia: Legal: approve banner text as-is. But require partner note to include measured delta and test config.
devops-bot: scheduled perf-sweep job #4851 for staging-us-west-2. Images: amd/mi300-microcode:test, nvidia/h200-fw:candidate, habana/gaudi-driver:2.7. ETA results: 6h.
amanda_amd: We'll upload microcode test image to the partner bucket and ping this channel when ready.
nathan_nvidia: Sharing compat matrix doc now: https://redwood-internal/share/compat-matrix-hw.
sylvia: Also reminder: SI contract teams need a notification template. Partnerships + Legal pls prepare.
sam: OK, actions: Alejandra (partnerships) draft partner note + compat matrix summary. Ken (marketplace) add banner + sku_flags. Eng-runtime run sweeps and post CSV. Legal/Marketing sign off on messaging. Vendors to provide test images. We reconvene here after perf-sweep or sooner on any vendor ETA change. :calendar:
